questions.q: Which part of a prompt does the lesson call the most important, and the one most people skip?
options: Role: who the AI should act as
Format: the shape of the answer
questions.explain: Context tells the AI who's involved, what you've tried and which constraints matter. Since the assistant has never met you, it's what turns a generic answer into your answer.

questions.q: Your AI answers keep coming back far longer than you want. Which part should you add to your prompt?
options: A role, such as "act as a friendly expert"
An example of a reply you didn't like
A format, such as "under 150 words, as bullets"
A broader task, such as "help me with this"
questions.explain: Format tells the AI what shape the answer should take. If you don't say, you get the default, which is often longer than you want.

questions.q: You want help with a goal but aren't sure what background the AI needs. What does the lesson suggest?
options: Send a one-line request and accept whatever comes back
Ask the AI to ask you up to five questions before it answers
Write a long essay that covers every detail of your life
Give it a role and leave out the context entirely
questions.explain: When you're unsure what to include, let the AI interview you with up to five questions first, so you end up with a great prompt without having to plan one.
